title: Privacy indicators for camera, microphone and screen capture are easy to miss: no app name without hovering, no way to show them outside the System Tray
line: When an app starts sharing your screen, a notification now names the app and has an End button.
explanation: When an app started a screencast through the portal, the only sign was a red tray icon, which can be hidden in the tray's overflow or off-screen, and named the app only in its tooltip. The portal also turns on Do Not Disturb for the duration of the sharing, so nothing else drew attention to it. Following Nate's direction (a server-side notification like Spectacle's), the portal now sends a 'Screen Sharing Started' notification naming the app, with an End button that stops the sharing; it closes itself when the sharing ends. It uses critical urgency so it still pops up through the screen-sharing Do Not Disturb.

commits.message:
screencast: show a notification when screen sharing starts
